key_findings: The Ly6 protein Belly roll (Bero), expressed in Drosophila ABLK neurons, negatively regulates nociceptive escape behavior; its knockdown enhanced escape.
Bero knockdown reduced persistent activity and increased evoked nociceptive responses in ABLK neurons, which are activated by nociceptors and initiate escape.
